document:0:609:0.text:
Mom and Dad brought me to a manor today. It has a garden with bluish-green plants, purplish-red flowers, and a pond filled with blood-red water... So strange.

Dad told me the manor belongs to a man named <style="highlight">Mortimer</style>. Mom and Dad work for him. Mom said I can stay here with them now. The servants here have mean faces. They have prepared a large bedroom for me, but I'm not allowed to share it with Mom and Dad. When I asked why, they said we just couldn't. I don't understand.

They gave me a book, the thickest I've ever seen, and said it has all the rules I need to follow while living in the manor. I hate how strict this place is! Ugh, I'd better take a break first before <style="highlight">going through the book</style>.
document:0:609:0.source_cn:
今天，爸爸妈妈带我来到了一座奇怪的庄园。这里有青蓝色的植物、紫红色的花，还有血红色的水池……不管怎么看，都很奇怪。
爸爸说这是<style="highlight">莫蒂默先生</style>的庄园，他是他们的雇主。妈妈说从今往后我可以和他们一起生活在这里，再也不用分开了，那些脸黑黑的仆人还给我安排了一间很宽敞的卧室。但是爸爸妈妈不能和我住在一起，我问为什么，他们只说就是不行，真奇怪。
他们还给了我一本很厚很厚的书，说是在庄园生活必须遵守的规矩。这里的规矩比爸爸妈妈和我约定的约法三章还要严格！好讨厌……还是先休息一下吧，等休息好了再来<style="highlight">读书</style>。

Appearance: Dark green, concentrated liquid in a brown bottle.
Effect: Separates a Graveborn's soul from their body, rendering them unconscious.
Usage: Add as many drops as needed. Just make sure the red wine does not change color.


Dear Father,

I am well aware of your disapproval of my plan, yet I also know you would rather remain in peaceful slumber than be disturbed, whether by my trifling affairs or by Bantus.

Good news for you: I have decided, for once, to be a good daughter. Here is what I propose—we shall leave the matter to what I do first on the morning of the banquet. <style="highlight">If I stretch, I shall heed your advice. If I yawn, I shall carry on with my plan.</style> After all, we must not appear weak when dealing with the Bantus, or Thoran will never take our terms seriously.

Should Bantus prove foolish enough to reject peace on my terms, we shall do it your way and make Novaris the most fearsome threat upon their frontier.

Minutes of the Novaris Branch Site Selection Meeting
Attendees: Pride, Sloth
Compiled by: Magic Recorder

Sloth consulted Pride regarding the location of the Novaris branch, mentioning the three previously proposed options: east of Ossuary Square, north of the Seasong Theater, and beneath the ruins of Darkmire Cliff.

Pride dismissed Sloth's proposals and insisted on establishing the branch <style="highlight">north of the commercial district, where a sealing magic circle stood</style>. Sloth objected to the idea, but without much conviction.

The two parties then engaged in a heated discussion. Below are some of Sloth's remarks:
"On top of a seal? If <style="highlight">that thing down there</style> breaks free, wouldn't the whole building come crashing down?"

"Let me be clear, this is nothing personal. As Lady Novaris, it's my duty to look out for my people. If something goes wrong, the Syndicate people can just pack up and leave, but I'd have to stay here and rebuild everything... That's far too much effort for me."

"It's not like you to be so unyielding... What game are you playing?"

"What you're trying to do could very well put Novaris in danger. As its ruler, shouldn't I concern myself with that?"

"Hmph... Have it your way, then. If anything goes wrong, don't think of shifting the blame onto me. Besides, I want an agreement guaranteeing Novaris' safety and outlining post-disaster measures, just in case."

"Of course, you can refuse to sign it. I'll simply sign it myself in both capacities, as Sloth of the Adamant Syndicate and as Lady Novaris."

I am not authorized to record Pride's remarks.

The meeting concluded with both parties reaching a consensus: the Novaris branch will be established at the <style="highlight">northernmost end of the commercial district</style>. The site will be elevated on top of the existing reef, with the <style="highlight">magic circle concealed underground</style>.

诺珐斯分部选址会议纪要
参会者：“傲慢”、“懒惰”
记录者：魔法会议记录器
“懒惰”向“傲慢”询问有关诺珐斯分部选址的建议，提及先前曾向其提供三个备选地点：称骨广场东侧、海歌剧院北侧、厄冥岩涯遗迹地下。
“傲慢”拒绝了“懒惰”的提议，坚持将选址定为<style="highlight">商业街北侧，隐秘封印阵所在之处</style>。这一想法遭到了“懒惰”的拒绝，但其情绪反应程度并不强烈。
随后双方展开争论。以下为“懒惰”的部分发言：
“建于封印之上？若是<style="highlight">被封印的那位</style>意外逃脱，商会大楼岂不是会轰然倒塌？”
“并非余要阻拦你，只是余作为诺珐斯领主，不得不考虑本地居民们的感受。万一当真发生意外，黑金商会大可直接撤离，可余还要耗费时间心力去重建诺珐斯……那岂不是太劳神了。”
“如此强硬……这可不像你。你又在盘算什么计谋？”
“你谋算之事极有可能危害诺珐斯，余作为领主难道不能过问一二？”
“哼……随你。若是未来某日封印阵引发灾祸，也不要妄想归咎于余。此外，余需要一份保障诺珐斯安全和可能的灾后重建的协议，以防万一。”
“你当然可以拒绝，那么余将以‘黑金商会之懒惰’与‘诺珐斯领主’这两个名义自行签署。”
由于权限设置，无法记录“傲慢”的具体发言。
最终，与会双方达成一致：诺珐斯分部选址为<style="highlight">商业街最北侧</style>，建造时将在原有礁石基础上提高地势，将<style="highlight">隐秘魔法阵藏于地下深处</style>。

say:5:1810644003:0.text: A ruler who's both a high-ranking member of the Syndicate and capable of maintaining autonomy under Bantus' rule wouldn't be so simple.
say:5:1810644003:0.source_cn: 一个既是黑金商会重要高层，又能在班题斯的强权下保持自治...

say:6:1810644005:1.text: Nothing she does follows logic. I can't make sense of her motives.
say:6:1810644005:1.source_cn: 苔佩希……她行事毫无章法可言，我猜不透她的动机。

say:7:1810644006:1.text: I don't care what her intentions are, as long as she doesn't harm the people of the empire. At least we know one thing now: <style="highlight">the candle blossoms given as souvenirs are harmless</style>.
say:7:1810644006:1.source_cn: 我不在乎她的意图——只要她不危害耀光人。至少现在我们可...

say:8:1810644007:1.text: And Baden and Baba Muriel are in the Refinery... We have to rescue them.
say:8:1810644007:1.source_cn: 而巴登和穆婆婆就在炼化间……该去救他们了。

say:9:1810644008:1.text: You can't go. If something should happen to you as well, the Rayne family—
say:9:1810644008:1.source_cn: 你不能去。若你也遭遇不测，瑞恩家族——

say:10:1810644009:0.text: I know what you're going to say. But even if Baden and I both die in Novaris, House Rayne will never fall.
say:10:1810644009:0.source_cn: 我知道你想说什么。但是，就算我和巴登最后都死在了诺珐斯...

say:11:1810644010:1.text: The name "Rayne" carries responsibility, not just glory. No matter who the lord or the heir is, protecting Ashvale County is our ultimate duty.
say:11:1810644010:1.source_cn: “瑞恩”之名所承载的不是荣耀，而是责任。无论家主、继承...

say:12:1810644011:1.text: I respect the conviction of the Rayne family more than anyone. But the perils of the Refinery far exceed your imagination. I can't let you risk yourself like this. Baden would never forgive me.
say:12:1810644011:1.source_cn: 我比任何人都尊重瑞恩家族的信念。但炼化间的凶险程度远超...

say:13:1810644012:1.text: No! He might be furious that you let his cousin walk into danger, but he would never condemn a Rayne ruler for doing what duty demands.
say:13:1810644012:1.source_cn: 不！或许他会因为你让他的堂妹身处险境而气愤，但他绝不会...

say:14:1810644013:1.text: If I can't bring him home to Ashvale, then I've failed as its lord!
say:14:1810644013:1.source_cn: 若不能把他带回灰影郡，我这个家主就是失职！

say:16:1810644015:1.text: Yelling at me won't work! Come with me to the Refinery to save Baden! Or are you going to defy your lord's command?
say:16:1810644015:1.source_cn: 吼我也没用！跟我去炼化间救巴登！你要违抗家主的命令吗？

say:19:1810644017:1.text: It's not that I don't trust her, it's—
say:19:1810644017:1.male: It's not that I don't trust her, it's—
say:19:1810644017:1.female: It's not that I don't trust her, it's—

say:20:1810644018:1.text: Even if we run into danger, we can face it together!
say:20:1810644018:1.source_cn: 就算遇到危险，我们也可以合力应对！

say:22:1810644021:0.text: You're just as stubborn as Baden, Estrilda.
say:22:1810644021:0.source_cn: ……你真是和巴登一样顽固，爱丝。

say:23:1810644022:1.text: I'm much better than him. At least I give you fair warning before I act.
say:23:1810644022:1.source_cn: 我比他好太多了，至少我会在行动之前通知你。
